limitations: mixed core types of the dev CPU

seeds.source: m8bench.progress (committed seed rows, not current live counts)

explorer\\scale.json.measurement: exact retained counts before load; not the requested seed target

explorer\\timeout-15000\\clients-16\\ing.latency_note: One sample per request at its final outcome of any status (202, 4xx, 5xx, timeout or transport error, 429 retries exhausted). latency_from_schedule runs from the request's scheduled due time to its final response, retry waits and dispatch lag included: judge API latency targets on it. dispatch_lag is the final send minus the scheduled time and service_latency the final attempt's send to response, so latency_from_schedule is about dispatch_lag plus service_latency.

explorer\\timeout-15000\\clients-16\\que.latency_note: Closed loop: one outstanding request per client, cycling through shapes with staggered starting shapes. Latency includes the entire body (CSV drained and discarded). Requests started before duration finish afterwards; latency includes all outcomes, successful_latency only complete 200 responses. No retries. Empty shapes invalidate the run.
explorer\\timeout-15000\\clients-16\\que.mix_note: Name plus source is replaced by name plus a seeded person: the explorer supports person_id, not source. The M8/M4 seed writes source=api on every event. category is low cardinality (six values); amount is high cardinality (0..200 at two decimal places).
